title: Remove Storybook entirely from apps/architecture-studio and packages/ui: uninstall packages, delete .storybook/ config, delete the /storybook route, delete packages/ui/stories/ and its generator
objective: Owner-directed rejection: 'se nao da pra unir entao nao vou usar o storybook, eu nao quero um servidor a parte para o storybook' (if it can't be unified then I won't use Storybook, I don't want a separate server for it). This task performs the actual removal of everything added under ARCH-STUDIO-STORYBOOK-INTEGRATION's original (now-superseded) Storybook approach: the storybook/@storybook/react-vite devDependencies, .storybook/ config, the /storybook Next.js route (page.tsx + storybook-client.tsx), packages/ui/stories/*.stories.tsx and packages/ui/scripts/generate-stories.mjs, and the storybook/build-storybook Nx targets on architecture-studio plus stories-generate/stories-check Nx targets on packages/ui. The replacement (an in-app component gallery, no second process) is tracked separately under ARCH-STUDIO-STORYBOOK-INTEGRATION. The packages/ui/documentation/mesh/ui-doc-mesh.meta.v1.json fix (self-contained DataTable/GridLayout example snippets) and docs/generated/meshes/ui-doc-mesh.v1.json regeneration are correct and kept -- not part of this removal.
validations: DONE: storybook and @storybook/react-vite removed from apps/architecture-studio/package.json devDependencies; pnpm install run at the workspace root, removed 90 packages from the lockfile.
DONE: apps/architecture-studio/src/app/storybook/ route deleted (confirmed absent from next build's route list).
DONE: packages/ui/stories/ directory and packages/ui/scripts/generate-stories.mjs deleted.
DONE: storybook/build-storybook Nx targets removed from apps/architecture-studio/project.json; stories-generate/stories-check Nx targets removed from packages/ui/project.json.
DONE: tsc --noEmit + next build clean for architecture-studio (routes now just /, /agents, /api/mcp, /lab); all 8 unit tests pass; packages/ui's own tsc/tests(9)/api-check all pass unchanged.
risks: Pure removal of unused, never-committed scaffolding -- no functional feature is lost since the replacement (in-app gallery) covers the same real intent (documenting @grafting/ui's components) without the rejected second-process constraint.
